item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"piece_id":"02","ready":false,"issues":["02-c1 combines two separate Backflip test results under one claim; split the two mass checks.","02-c1 locators do not support the stated STEP, Fusion, 1060-aluminum, or mass-check details; cite the exact passages for each test.","02-c2 combines incomplete Fusion recreation and the seven-body failure; make separate claims.","02-c3 labels an interpretation as a reported fact and lacks a locator for “707 cases”; split the count from the survey’s reproducibility conclusion.","02-c5 combines the 63-of-84 result with task-category differences; make separate podcast claims.","02-c7 overstates a mass match as “neutral-solid correctness”; the test established mass for two specified exercises, not complete solid correctness.","02-c7 turns one publisher’s observations into a release-gate recommendation without independent supporting evidence; narrow it or connect a separately cited second producer.","The argument’s “strongest current evidence” and “not autonomous engineering workflows” claims exceed the supplied checks; limit them to the cited Backflip exercises and survey scope.","The synthesis treats geometry, native editability, tolerance compliance, manufacturability, and downstream execution as one implied evaluation prescription; separate the supported observations from a narrowly scoped inference.","The required written, podcast, and YouTube coverage across the three-piece series cannot be verified from this brief because it cites no YouTube evidence."]}
